The '''Kur forests'''<ref name="AIR" /> were located in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Kur Minor system/Legends|Kur Minor system]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> They featured [[thorn vine]]s, an infamous [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]].<ref name="AIR" /> At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Casti Tholon]] made a trek through the Kur [[Forest/Legends|forests]]. In the process, she was severely cut by the thorn [[Vine/Legends|vines]], acquiring numerous scars on her head, [[Limb/Legends|arms]], and lower legs.<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kur forests were mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" />
